name: t5s_neutral_a
description: Phase 3 T5s NEUTRALITY CONTROL (wind). The t5probe_a run (isnd=5, iwnd=4: CM1's 35 tanh(z/3 km) profile) re-run with the same environment through the external sounding: WK82 reference thermodynamics + wind kind=tanh, u_max=35, z_scale=3000. GATE (plan section 4.1): u0 at t=0 must match t5probe_a's u0 at every level (|du| < 0.2 m/s), v0 = 0, AND the deck's iwnd=0 must NOT have zeroed the wind -- the source read (2026-09-02) SETTLED that CM1 takes the wind from the file and ignores iwnd at isnd=7 -- base.F:466, base.F:2263, param.F:836-853, which forces iwnd=0 non-fatally -- so this run CONFIRMS it empirically rather than deciding it. Storm: same supercell family as A (peak w within 5 %). imove=1 with umove=23 as A used.
